events.title: Public Speaking Workshop
events.description: TEDxCMU public speaking workshop. The event date is confirmed as September 27, 2026. Official sources conflict on the time and venue: the homepage says 2:00 PM at Simmons Auditorium; the Events page says 5:00 PM at DH 1212; the linked public RSVP form says 3:00 PM at DH 1212. Time and venue require organizer confirmation. This record has date precision and does not assert an all-day event.

selectedText:
Speaker Workshop

Public Speaking Workshop

Join TEDxCMU for our first annual Speaking Workshop.

Learn about what makes a TED Talk shine, how to apply speaking insights to your everyday life, and build your talk-writing skills with us.

You’ll be able to hear from some of our previous student speakers, too!

When: September 27, 2026 • 5:00 PM

Where: DH 1212, Carnegie Mellon University

RSVP
